## Session Report

* [J-A1 report: diagram and integrate artifacts refuse another enumeration](J-A1-report.md) - ENUMERATION_VERSION is recorded in both artifacts (diagram format 3, integrate format 24) and a mismatch is refused by name with the remedy. A known-answer test pins seven cards' set and process-facts digests to it, and two sign mutations showed it fails on an unbumped change.
* [J-E1 report: the SMEFTsim four-quark compile panic](J-E1-report.md) - Two causes behind the panic on SMEFTsim u u~ > t t~ b b~ NP<=1, each fixed with a failing-first test and a MadGraph standalone oracle; the target process disagrees with MadGraph because of two defects found here and filed: a W between the t and b lines beside a third line, and a dipole on an initial-state quark line.
* [J-E2 report: fixed-energy sde_strategy 2 panics on two decay-chain subprocesses; the forests are now per subprocess](J-E2-report.md) - A fixed-energy sde_strategy = 2 card with two decay-chain lines that reach one ordered final state through different forced resonances panicked in ChannelSet::channel_cuts, because the forests were derived over the union of every subprocess's diagrams and indexed with the first subprocess's configuration count. use_running_coupling now takes one diagram list per subprocess and derives one ChannelSet each. Cards whose subprocesses share diagrams, and single-subprocess cards, give bit-identical sigma.
* [J-W1 report: the pairing-weighted cut_decays exemption, its guard, its probe and its σ attribution](J-W1-report.md) - cut_decays = F with identical particles across a decay is now Σ_p w_p Θ_p |M|². The weighted integrand has no beam-collinear pole (w|M|²ε² falls as ε², |M|²ε² flat). σ reads +1.72% above MadGraph on g g > z u u~, z > u u~ and +0.44% on g g > z j j, z > j j. Per event that is the interference plus the window union, with zero from the exemption. MadGraph's rule read on vibegraph's events closes on MadGraph's σ to 0.1%.
